cards.title: Rinx 14U Pulls Away From LI Sharks, 9-3, to Stay Unbeaten
cards.body: Rinx 14U scored four times in the first period and four more in the third to beat LI Sharks 9-3 on Sunday at The Rinx. The LIAHL 14U Silver win kept Rinx perfect at 5-0-0-0, while the Sharks fell to 2-3-1-0.

cards.title: Fox, Pierre Canel Each Score Three as Rinx 10U Blanks LI Sharks 9-0
cards.body: Sean Fox and DJ Pierre Canel each recorded a hat trick, and Rinx 10U beat LI Sharks 9-0 on Sunday morning at Iceland. Rinx scored in every period and stayed unbeaten in LIAHL 10U Silver play.

cards.title: Rinx 10U Stays Unbeaten With 9-0 Shutout of Long Beach
cards.body: Rinx 10U scored in every period and got a combined shutout from Connor Daly and Louie Savola in a 9-0 win over Long Beach Lightning on Saturday morning at Long Beach Municipal Ice Arena.

cards.title: Fox, Grosskurth Lead 10U Past Long Island Gulls
cards.body: Sean Fox and Matthew Grosskurth each scored twice and Connor Daly made 14 saves as the 10U Squirts beat Long Island Gulls 4-2 to improve to 4-0 at the Mid-Atlantic Fall Classic.

cards.title: Grosskurth's Four-Goal Game Leads 10U Past Genesis Hockey Club
cards.body: Matthew Grosskurth scored four goals and Connor Daly made 14 saves as the 10U Squirts beat Genesis Hockey Club 5-2 to improve to 3-0 at the Mid-Atlantic Fall Classic.

cards.title: Savola Blanks Central Penn Panthers as 10U Wins 8-0
cards.body: Jorge Leonardo and Matthew Grosskurth each scored twice and Louie Savola posted the shutout as the 10U Squirts beat Central Penn Panthers 8-0 to improve to 2-0 at the Mid-Atlantic Fall Classic.

cards.title: 10U Opens Mid-Atlantic With 7-1 Win Over Delco Phantoms
cards.body: Sean Fox and Aiden Brown each scored twice and Connor Daly made 14 saves as the 10U Squirts beat Delco Phantoms 7-1 to open the Mid-Atlantic Fall Classic.

cards.title: Fine Scores Twice as Unbeaten Rinx 14U Beats Peconic Diaz 7-1
cards.body: Cameron Fine scored twice and six different players found the net as Rinx 14U beat the Peconic Wildcats 7-1 on Saturday at The Rinx. Rinx 14U outshot Peconic 52-17 and remained perfect at 4-0-0-0.

cards.title: Grosskurth's Hat Trick Powers Rinx 10U Past Long Beach, 10-2
cards.body: Matthew Grosskurth scored three goals, and Rinx 10U beat Long Beach Lightning 10-2 on Sunday at The Rinx. The meeting of unbeaten LIAHL 10U Silver teams went Rinx’s way from the start.

cards.title: Five Different Scorers Lift Rinx 14U Past North Park Pala, 5-1
cards.body: Five different players scored for Rinx 14U in a 5-1 win over North Park Hockey on Saturday at The Rinx. Brody Meyer, Luka Mazzarone, Kosta Krokidis, Aedan Dowling and Luke Ventura each had one goal as Rinx improved to 3-0-0-0 in LIAHL 14U Silver play.

cards.title: Leonardo's Hat Trick Leads Rinx 10U Silver to 13-0 Win Over North Park
cards.body: Jorge Leonardo scored three goals and Connor Daly posted a shutout as Rinx 10U beat North Park Hockey 13-0 in LIAHL 10U Silver regular-season play Sunday at The Rinx.

cards.title: Ohliger Scores Twice as Rinx 14U Shuts Out Great Neck Bruins 7-0
cards.body: Ryan Ohliger scored two goals and Joe Azar recorded a shutout as Rinx 14U beat the Great Neck Bruins 7-0 in LIAHL 14U Silver play Sunday at The Rinx. The win moved Rinx to 2-0-0-0.

cards.title: Rinx 10U Opens Season With 8-2 Win at Peconic
cards.body: Rinx 10U scored four goals in the first period and never looked back, beating the Peconic Wildcats 8-2 in the season opener for both teams Sunday at Peconic Ice Rink.

cards.title: Rinx 14U Beat Peconic Diaz 8-3 Despite Clark Beltram Hat Trick
cards.body: Rinx 14U beat the Peconic Wildcats 8-3 on Saturday at Peconic Ice Rink in the season opener for both LIAHL 14U Silver teams. Six different Rinx players scored, while Peconic’s Clark Beltram recorded a hat trick and accounted for all of his team’s goals.
